S_QUALIFICATION_RUN.input_binding: exact sealed C6-Base L1 factual trace from I_B and R
S_QUALIFICATION_RUN.residual_formula: all L1 economic IDs whose C6-Base abs(official max_drawdown) > 0.18 + 1e-15
S_QUALIFICATION_RUN.qualification_formula: For every residual ID, q1 AND q2 AND q3 AND q4 AND q5 AND q6 AND q7 must be true; complete residual coverage and all_passed are required. An empty residual set makes this run not_applicable and S must not run.

criteria.formula: The Base factual path contains first_official_mdd_breach as defined by the official sampler and running peak.
At least one currently authorized causal stressed-cluster evidence decision close is strictly earlier than first_official_mdd_breach.
The existing concentration guard's deterministic real-notional worst_cluster has weight > 0.80 and belongs to the complete same-close stressed_cluster_set.

Observed-count, freshness, coverage and unmapped-weight gates all pass, and recomputing with every target-held-cluster component removed preserves the same fixed-threshold stress evidence; a truly disjoint basket is a pass.

The frozen scheduler supplies at least one execution batch between evidence close and breach; S would set early_sell_required before that breach while legacy_gate_open is false; at least one planned sell remains a nonzero executable lot after T+1, open, limit, suspension, ADV/capacity and lot rules.
The one scheduler-selected action batch and its sell execution ordering are strictly earlier than the official breach valuation sample; no later fill date may be searched.

Using the official running peak and frozen open marks, first compute pre_trade_open_drawdown. Fail only when abs(pre_trade_open_drawdown) > 0.18 + 1e-15 and either the official sampler samples that pre-fill open or the next official sample is proven to use the identical valuation instant and marks while self-financing execution plus nonnegative costs cannot improve that instant. Otherwise record OPEN_MARK_GAP and pass this criterion.

S_QUALIFICATION_RUN.missing_extra_and_order_rule: Top-level, result and nested objects must contain exactly their listed keys with no extras; arrays use the frozen order; any type, enum, range, identity, count, order, missing-key or extra-key mismatch fails closed.

S_QUALIFICATION_RUN.hashing: After exact schema validation, hash the entire top-level qualification object and every nested field using canonical_result_payload_hashing.serialization; publish an external full-byte SHA-256 sidecar after atomic seal without modifying the qualification artifact.

selection_rule.step_1: Run the one frozen I_B L1 batch containing every preregistered ablation and C6-Base.
selection_rule.step_2: If correctness, identity, architecture or no-drift fails, stop; S cannot repair correctness.
selection_rule.step_3: Derive R_L1 mechanically from every L1 economic result with abs(max_drawdown) > 0.18 + 1e-15.
selection_rule.step_4: If R_L1 is empty, select I_B only if every L1 predicate passes; never run S for return improvement.
selection_rule.step_5: If R_L1 is nonempty, run S_QUALIFICATION_RUN on every residual; run exactly one I_S L1 only if all residuals pass.
selection_rule.step_6: Select I_S only if every Base+S L1 predicate passes; otherwise write rejected D and stop.
selection_rule.step_7: D is the sole evidence-only child of R and binds all L1 hashes, residuals, qualification hash or null, selected candidate and C.
selection_rule.step_8: Only D-selected C may run the frozen L2 and, after every L2 predicate passes, the single L4.

economic_tree_and_A.allowed_change: only add or modify regular non-executable 100644 blobs at exact allowlisted paths; no delete, rename, symlink or gitlink

manifest_record_value_contract.path_b64: standard RFC 4648 padded base64 of the exact raw repo-relative path bytes
manifest_record_value_contract.mode: six ASCII Git mode digits from ls-tree

economic_tree_and_A.manifest_algorithm: Read the entire tracked tree using git-ls-tree -rz --full-tree semantics; remove only exact A_ALLOWLIST paths; construct each object with exactly manifest_record_exact_keys and no others; sort records by decoded raw path bytes; serialize the record array with json.dumps(records, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) plus one LF encoded as UTF-8; SHA-256 the exact bytes.
economic_tree_and_A.required_proof: git diff --raw -z C A touches only allowed 100644 add/modify paths and economic_tree_hash(C) equals economic_tree_hash(A)
economic_tree_and_A.fallback: If source/head validation or required CI would rerun L4, keep A null and retain the sealed workflow artifact externally.

stop_conditions: Any real scenario or backtest economic field is dispatched, enqueued or inspected before P, I_B, I_S and R are all frozen and remotely verified.
Any frozen workflow, dependency, data, scenario, reference, gate, comparator, seed, parallel merge order or account-lock identity drifts.
Warm-state audit finds unauthorized holdings, cash, PnL, peaks, pending orders, locks or future information.
Data audit finds an invalid or universe-dependent old-symbol raw frame or causal indicator.
Base correctness, identity, architecture or no-drift fails.
Any Base residual fails S qualification, or the sole Base+S L1 fails an applicable predicate.
Selected C fails any L2 predicate or any L4 formal gate.
A third candidate, parameter search, threshold change, scenario change, reference change, gate change or second L4 logical run is proposed.
Main tracked tree drifts from the frozen base before economic completion.
Required review or CI has an unresolved Critical or Important result.
Atomic expected-base merge provenance or supported merge-queue equivalent is unavailable at final merge time.
